data.key: Forbidden Ki Power ~ Black Asp Venom
data.name: Black Asp Venom
data.description: As a swift action, a black asp with this ki power can poison his unarmed strike or a weapon in his hand. The poison lasts for 1 minute or until expended. A creature damaged by the poisoned weapon is affected as per the poison spell. The save DC is %1. Each use of this ability costs 2 ki points.|10+MonkLVL/2+WIS
